 Santa Clara basketball guard Elijah Mahi has discussed the Broncos' unbeaten 5-0 start and their upcoming matchup against VCU at the Leavey Center during an appearance on the WCC Insider podcast. The conversation featured Field of 68 hosts Rob Dauster and Jeff Goodman.
 Mahi joined the podcast to discuss Santa Clara's early-season performance as the Broncos maintained a perfect record through their first five games. The discussion also focused on the team's upcoming challenge against VCU.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 The matchup against VCU is scheduled to take place at the Leavey Center, Santa Clara's home venue. The game represents the next fixture highlighted during Mahi's podcast appearance.

 The interview was featured in the November 17, 2026, edition of WCC Insider, according to the West Coast Conference's official sports website, WCCsports.com.
 The WCC Insider podcast also features conversations with players from other conference programs. Its November 10 episode featured San Diego's Dusty Stromer, while the November 6 episode featured Ismaila Diagne of San Francisco.
